_readme: Chief copies this to /workspace/cog-team/context/cog.json and fills it in during the intake (/workspace/cog-team/repo/config/intake-interview.md). Every value marked REQUIRED must be real before any COG routine is switched on; a routine that finds one missing replies NO_CLIENT_SOURCE and stops. No passwords, tokens or API keys belong in this file.

business.name: Circle of Greatness
business._timezone_note: Reports and schedules are Eastern (Chris chose Eastern Daylight on Oct 16). Set the same time zone in Grok Bot Settings; routines run in the cloud on it.

owner.name: Chris
owner._report_channel_note: chat = each bot's own chat with Chris in Grok Bot (the default).

eod.source_type: REQUIRED one of: google_sheet | slack_workflow_channel | ghl_form | other
eod.slack_channel_id: REQUIRED (the KPI channel the bot reads and, once Chris gives standing approval 1 at M4, posts the EOD bump in)
eod.slack_workspace: REQUIRED: the Slack workspace the KPI channel is in (WeScale or COG's own). Decides which Slack connection reads it.
eod._test_channel_note: Optional: a Slack channel only Chris is in. Used only by the go-live test in START-HERE Step 11; the bump in test mode posts here, never in the KPI channel.
eod.identity_column: REQUIRED (the form field that says which rep submitted, e.g. 'Name' or 'Email')
eod.report_date_rule: submissions before cutoff count for the previous selling day

field_map._comment: Left side = standard field (docs/KPI-DEFINITIONS.md). Right side = the exact column/question name in Chris's form. Use null for fields his form does not have.

ghl.connection: ghl-super-hub command line at /workspace/cog-team/ghl-super-hub/ghl with a read-only private-integration token. The token is never written in this file.

appointment_status_map._comment: Map GHL appointment statuses / outcomes to standard ones.

dispositions._comment: The exact disposition names the team must use (pipeline stage, custom field or tag). Fill from Chris's SOP.
dispositions.field: REQUIRED e.g. custom field 'Call Outcome' or opportunity stage

steps.label: Call attempt #1
steps.evidence: outbound call in GHL to the lead

steps.label: Setter notified
steps.evidence: Slack message/thread mentioning the setter or lead, or GHL note/task

steps.label: GHL notes/disposition updated
steps.evidence: appointment status = no_show and disposition set

targets._comment: Optional. Leave null if Chris has none yet; the report then shows trend vs. prior period instead of vs. target.

bump._identity_options: bot (recommended; the team Slack app's bot token, shows as COG Sales Manager) | chris (posts through the Slack connector signed in as Chris, shows as him; no token)
bump.template_first: {mentions} — EOD KPIs are missing for {report_date}. It's {time} ET. Please submit now. Cutoff is {cutoff} ET.
bump.template_final: {mentions} — final call: EOD KPIs for {report_date} are still missing. Cutoff is {cutoff} ET.

calls.transcript_source: REQUIRED for Growth Operator: ghl_recordings | zoom | read_ai | fathom | other

knowledge.jeremy_haynes_kb_url: REQUIRED for Pre-Call Concierge (the repo / here.now page built on Oct 16)

vault._note: The vault lives on the bot computer and is the source of truth. Chief copies it to the Drive folder 'GrokBot Vault' every night (routines/chief-vault-backup.prompt) so Chris can open it in Obsidian. Drive is the backup, not the home.
